name: Go Fmt on Save
description: Runs gofmt on Go files after Claude edits them to ensure standard formatting
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Run gofmt on edited Go files
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.go$ ]]; then
  if command -v gofmt &>/dev/null; then
    gofmt -w "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
    echo "Formatted $FILE with gofmt"
  else
    echo "gofmt not found, skipping format"
  fi
fi
exit 0
